relationships.evidence_quote: PCB126 (0.1 nM) significantly increased GAS6 mRNA levels in both IHEECs

relationships.subject: GAS6
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with GAS6 (50 ng/mL) significantly increased ESR2 transcriptional activity compared to vehicle-treated controls

relationships.subject: BMS-777607
relationships.evidence_quote: BMS-777607 treatment significantly reduced the volume of endometriotic lesions in PCB126-exposed mice compared to the vehicle-treated group

relationships.subject: ESR2
relationships.evidence_quote: ESR2 functions as a key transcriptional regulator that directly upregulates Dnmt3a expression in the uterine endometrium

relationships.subject: PCB126
relationships.evidence_quote: PCB126 exposure significantly upregulates Dnmt3a expression in endometriotic lesions in a mouse model of endometriosis

key_findings: PCB126 promotes endometriosis lesion growth via an AXL/GAS6-ESR2-DNMT3A axis and increases MMP-9 and ESR2.
Dnmt3a knockout reduces lesion growth and immunosuppressive cytokine/chemokine expression.
